reply.text:
You can train fine without a plan built around skipping carbs, and I'd gently push back on cutting them out entirely. Carbs are the fuel for hard lifting and running, so training on none tends to feel flat, and that usually shows up in your numbers before it shows up anywhere else.

Being scared of a food is worth taking seriously on its own. If it's more fear than a food preference, a doctor or dietitian is the right person to talk it through with, and I'm glad to keep training with you while you do.

On the training side, nothing needs to change: lifting, easy runs, and walks all work, and I'd just keep the effort honest to how you feel. If you want, tell me what you've been doing lately and I'll look at how your sessions have been going.
